Based on the chest X-ray findings, what is the most likely diagnosis for the ovoid mass in the right paracardiac region (Figure 1a), considering the clinical history of right lower chest discomfort for 10 months? 

A) Pericardial cyst
B) Right middle lobe pneumonia
C) Pleural effusion
D) Paracardiac pleural Castleman disease of the hyaline-vascular subtype
E) Cardiomegaly
F) Right lower lobe atelectasis
